justification: The primary Article 11 complaint (the 2012 banner incident) is examined and decided under Article 10 read in light of Article 11 rather than as a standalone Article 11 finding, and the separate Article 11 complaint (the 2011 event) is disposed of by reference to well-established case-law without a unified merits analysis, so the case lacks both a single coherent Article 11 merits analysis and a genuine standalone Article 11 adjudication.
